title: Travel: John Lennon – New York to Los Angeles | 1976
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono travelled from New York to Los Angeles on 25 May 1976.

The main purpose of the trip was for Lennon to take part in recording sessions for Ringo Starr’s album Ringo’s Rotogravure. Lennon contributed the song ‘Cookin’ (In The Kitchen Of Love)’, which was recorded on 27 May.
